item.title: ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION at 30: Members Talk New Releases ‘Fujieda EP’ & ‘Skins,’ Making Music for a Fractured World, More
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest trends and stories from the music world. Today, we're shining the spotlight on Japan's ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION, who have just dropped a new EP called Fujieda, along with a single titled "Skins". Let's take a closer look.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: The Fujieda EP was recorded entirely at MUSIC inn Fujieda, a unique residential recording studio built inside a 130-year-old renovated storehouse. We spoke with the band's members about their experience recording at this special studio.
[Clip of Masafumi Gotoh speaking]
Masafumi Gotoh: "I wanted to create a more accessible space where people could really take their time making music... We used crowdfunding and a lot of people's support to get it finished."
Host: The band's guitarist, Kensuke Kita, was impressed by the studio's acoustics.
[Clip of Kensuke Kita speaking]
Kensuke Kita: "The drum sound in particular was fantastic. I was impressed because it was clear they built the space with that sound in mind."
Host: The studio's history and renovation also left a lasting impression on the band's drummer, Kiyoshi Ijichi.
[Clip of Kiyoshi Ijichi speaking]
Kiyoshi Ijichi: "It's impressive that a storehouse like this still exists in Fujieda. Renovation must cost more than clearing the land and building from scratch... It gives neighborhoods a cohesive beauty."
Host: The band's latest single, "Skins", is also making waves as the opening theme for the TV anime Dr. STONE: SCIENCE FUTURE Season 3. We'll be keeping an eye on ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION as they head into their 30th anniversary overseas shows and Ariake Arena concert.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. Join us next time for more exciting stories from the music world.
